mentions.name: Ask The W
mentions.description: An AI product aimed at product managers, pitched as a "Cursor for AI PMs/Forward Deployed PMs." Rather than generating PRDs, roadmaps, spreadsheets, decks, or OKRs, it targets the real PM job of quick alignment, principled decision-making, and leadership buy-in with little to no data, starting by orchestrating humans and agents to make better decisions.
mentions.problem: Most engineer-built "Cursor for PMs" tools focus on generating artifacts like PRDs and roadmaps, but they don't solve the real PM job of achieving quick alignment, principled decision-making, and leadership buy-in with little to no data, which no AI tool reliably solves today.
mentions.audience: AI PMs and Forward Deployed PMs (the next generation of product managers)
